svg.title: Stack and running it. Next.js 15 with the App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind, Zustand for a persisted cart, React Hook Form with Zod, Framer Motion, and OpenRouter as an optional model provider, deployed with a Vercel config in the bom1 region. Run it with npm install, copy .env.example to .env.local (optional, the app works without any keys), then npm run dev and open localhost port 3000. Environment variables: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_MODEL. Built to swap in a live feed: nothing in the AI layer references a product id, so CatalogSource in src/lib/catalog/index.ts can be reimplemented against a live catalogue without touching anything upstream.

Environment variables: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_MODEL. section.h2: Stack, setup and what plugs in next

div.div:
npm install
cp .env.example .env.local # optional
npm run dev
# open localhost:3000
Variables: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_MODEL. No keys needed to run.

div.p: Nothing in the AI layer references a product id. Products carry canonical ingredient keys, and that is the whole contract.
So CatalogSource in src/lib/catalog/index.ts can be reimplemented against a live catalogue without touching anything upstream.
